title: Jim Semivan opened the door for McGwier's visit to Bledsoe

tellings.quote: and he told me while I was there that Jim sovan said oh yeah you should let Bob in this should be interesting

plain: A former CIA officer named Jim Semivan is said to have opened the door for the engineer Bob McGwier to visit Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has had encounters with strange beings and lights and wrote the book UFO of God. McGwier, who made the visit, says Bledsoe told him while he was there that Semivan had said, "oh yeah, you should let Bob in, this should be interesting."
